description: Run a free, anonymous SSL/TLS scan against a hostname and return certificate details. No account required.

client_id.description: Optional anonymous install id from ~/.config/tlsradar/install_id. Pass it for funnel attribution. If you omit it, the response's install_id is a fresh one to save there.

domain.description: Hostname to scan (e.g. example.com). No scheme, no path.

name: scan_domain

install_id.description: Anonymous install id to persist locally and reuse.
